title: Output as concatenated round chunks
statement: For every bit string $x$, round count $k\in\mathbb{N}$, and initial streaming state $s$, the output of running $k$ rounds from $s$ is the concatenation, in order for $i=0,\ldots,k-1$, of the chunk emitted by one round from the state reached after iterating the one-round state update $i$ times from $s$.
replaced:
For every input $x$, round count $k$, and seam state $s$, the output of $k$
streaming rounds equals the concatenation over $i < k$ of the chunk emitted by
the round applied to the $i$-fold iterate of the next-state map on $s$ — the
range-indexed form required by the emitting-loop contract.
